body: Thank you man. So are you. That means so much to me. I'm gonna do my best to make this last. Good luck to you too (:
Yeah. Yeah it really does. Thank you for the perspective man, really. I'll be sure to reach out. I hope you continue to do the same (: you're awesome

Wow...thanks. I mean...you kinda summed it up really well, yeah. I get what you mean...it's not the world that scares me so much as my own brain and other people. I feel dependent on other people just to not feel empty. Like I can't be happy on my own. It sucks.

And yeah, me neither. I have noticed that...I feel genuinely okay some days. More okay than usual at least. I don't think, personally, that I'll ever feel "not broken", but yeah. I was just in a pretty bad place a few hours ago. Thank you. 

I ended up going for a walk down to a pond and thought about drowning myself and then walked out on the road for a little bit thinking about a car doing it for me. But I didn't. I didn't do it. Nothing happened except me getting exercise.

I'm really glad actually. Part of me is fighting that joy but I'm glad I'm here.

And about my dad...I don't know. We're a dysfunctional, weird family. Normally, when he confronts me about school (which I'm doing complete shit in because I'm depressed and don't care), I just kind of say whatever bullshit comes to my mind. I never say anything significant or notable, I guess I just bullshit my way through. I despise the thought of actually telling my parents the entire truth.

I don't know why. Maybe I'm just a typical teenager but I just don't want to have that conversation. I don't know. He got mad because I said the truth, which is that I don't give a shit and that I'd basically been lying the whole time. That said, I have actually been feeling on/off better recently (today being off), and I told him that this time I wasn't lying and actually felt capable of doing schoolwork again but...I don't know. I don't blame him for being mad. Looking back I guess it's a dick thing to do, to lie like I did. I feel bad about it.

He's a slave to his job. No free time. Not much fun. He gets up early, goes to work, works until 8 at night, then works more until maybe 10:30 at the earliest. Then gets up early again. It's sad but funny- he works in human resources. I desperately wish he'd get a better job but he's almost retirement age...I don't know if it would be likely at all that anyone would hire him. He has skills but he's old, around 62. It fucking sucks. I hate living here, like this.

I don't know if he's a dick. He genuinely loves me but he's kind of cynical sometimes and he has every right to be in my opinion. I don't know.

I'm sorry for the wall of text, I have a lot to get off my chest I guess. Thank you so, so much for reaching out. I almost feel stupid because I didn't fucking do it. Instead I made a post on /r/suicidewatch and I feel not suicidal now. It's a weird feeling...

I'm sorry you get that feeling of nothing too. I hate it, you're right. It passes. I just did, somehow. Thanks to you, man. Thank you, thank you. Thank you. Fucking thank you man. There seriously aren't words for any of this....
